tests/test_authoring.py.risk: A malformed or ambiguous hook policy could permit a blocked tool or overwrite a package.
tests/test_authoring.py.oracle: Replay the native hook protocol and CLI against valid, invalid, duplicate-key and standalone-copy cases; inspect actual decisions, exits and preserved files.
tests/test_authoring.py.overlap: Adds Testify CLI planning, no-overwrite, invalid-input, real execution and mutation detection; this is distinct from native linter and hook policy tests.

tests/test_bootstrap.py.risk: A remote installer could run a planted checkout or ignore failed fast-forward acquisition.
tests/test_bootstrap.py.oracle: Git stubs simulate acquisition failures; shell execution must stop before the planted program and must produce the correct isolated checkout.
tests/test_bootstrap.py.overlap: Acquisition is distinct from target link setup; prerequisite/tarball variants stay in test_install.

tests/test_codify.py.risk: Frozen executable publication could accept stale, escaping or corrupt inputs, or publish half an artifact.
tests/test_codify.py.oracle: Compile and execute real local programs; mutate source, cases, inventory and publication timing; assert rejection, immutable execution and atomic publication.
tests/test_codify.py.overlap: Compiler and artifact semantics stay here; command-schema parsing and normalized skill transport use smaller separate fixtures.

tests/test_command_schema.py.risk: CLI and OpenAI call inputs could diverge, escape package resources or accept invalid typed arguments.
tests/test_command_schema.py.oracle: Invoke actual generated CLI and API calls, compare typed outputs/exits, and verify read-only help and rejected signatures preserve state.
tests/test_command_schema.py.overlap: Boundary coercion and routing cases are not repeated as whole skill workflows; compiler freeze invariants remain in test_codify.

tests/test_constrain.py.risk: A constraint gate could admit noise, stale staged approval or oversized ignored build outputs.
tests/test_constrain.py.oracle: Invoke the real CLI against isolated Git snapshots, known-bad/good tests, exact exceptions, symlinks and deployment byte/growth boundaries.
tests/test_constrain.py.overlap: Exercises lock, staged snapshot, missing parser, recognized bootstrap fetches, document, boundary and built-directory budgets; each detects a separate user-visible rule failure.

tests/test_docs_hooks.py.risk: A staged check can read working-tree bytes, miss sparse files, or accept stale documentation.
tests/test_docs_hooks.py.oracle: Execute the actual Git hook and compare worktree, sparse and staged observations. Maintainer hook selection now belongs to Git itself.
tests/test_docs_hooks.py.overlap: Retains staged snapshot and hook wiring behavior; test_constrain separately owns constraint predicates, not documentation freshness.

tests/test_experiment_evaluate.py.risk: An ineligible, incomplete, substituted or regressing result could be promoted as an improvement.
tests/test_experiment_evaluate.py.oracle: Independent labeled measurements, provenance kinds, changed grade receipts, retained submission/case bytes and repeated noisy baselines must produce the correct eligibility or inconclusive result.
tests/test_experiment_evaluate.py.overlap: Tests pure paired evaluation and regrade decisions; higher-layer tests exercise persisted controller receipts.

tests/test_experiment_factory.py.risk: A task draft could overwrite data, infer unsupported criteria or escape the declared repository scope.
tests/test_experiment_factory.py.oracle: Real Git fixtures and the compiled entry point must produce a fact-only draft while rejecting invalid paths, aliases and overwrites.
tests/test_experiment_factory.py.overlap: The draft boundary is distinct from the executable experiment controller.

tests/test_experiment_git.py.risk: Private experiment arms, guarded promotion, and cleanup could lose user work or act on a redirected Git store.
tests/test_experiment_git.py.oracle: Real temporary Git repositories exercise guarded competing ref moves, scoped freezing, retained bundles, interrupted retirement, path redirection, and disabled hooks and filters.
tests/test_experiment_git.py.overlap: Exercises Git ownership and lifecycle; controller tests separately cover decisions and evidence.

tests/test_experiment_handoff.py.risk: A private champion could be delivered without matching the evaluated tree, evidence, scope or current delivery base.
tests/test_experiment_handoff.py.oracle: Real isolated Git repositories must stage the exact promoted tree and preserve measured source provenance while rejecting stale, dirty, tampered, unconfirmed and unsafe-filter cases.
tests/test_experiment_handoff.py.overlap: Exercises the separate-worktree handoff boundary; promotion and controller tests validate the private ref and retained decision.

tests/test_experiment_integration.py.risk: Stale evidence, invalid confirmation, changed evaluator inputs or interrupted promotion could advance the wrong candidate.
tests/test_experiment_integration.py.oracle: CLI, Git and SQLite fixtures exercise feedback, regrading, confirmation, crash recovery, same-tree source provenance and tamper rejection against retained decisions and refs.
tests/test_experiment_integration.py.overlap: Covers public controller integration; component evaluation and Git lifecycle tests cover narrower invariants.

tests/test_experiment_integrity.py.risk: Spoofed verifiers, reused assignments, wrong case bytes or fabricated calibration could authorize an invalid comparison.
tests/test_experiment_integrity.py.oracle: Real controller calls and stored receipts must reject forged, duplicate, stale and unattested inputs while accepting a bound case.
tests/test_experiment_integrity.py.overlap: Targets authority boundaries and selection uniqueness beyond the general lifecycle.

tests/test_experiment_lean.py.risk: An invalid budget theorem or an implementation that undercounts reservations could be mistaken for a proved spending bound.
tests/test_experiment_lean.py.oracle: Run the pinned Lean checker and compare its generated reservation and settlement cases to SQLite; deliberately weakened proofs and an undercounting ledger must be rejected.
tests/test_experiment_lean.py.overlap: Lean proves abstract arithmetic and the finite bridge checks correspondence; concurrent SQLite and TLA+ tests exercise distinct implementation and state-machine risks.

tests/test_experiment_ledger.py.risk: Concurrent reservations, duplicate dispatches, ambiguous outcomes, or overruns could exceed the experiment budget.
tests/test_experiment_ledger.py.oracle: Real SQLite transactions and concurrent claimants assert persisted reservations, selection uniqueness, settlement, cancellation evidence, and restart behavior.
tests/test_experiment_ledger.py.overlap: Checks the durable ledger directly; the finite model explores an abstract state machine and controller tests verify callers.

tests/test_experiment_maf.py.risk: The workflow could reorder actions, proceed after failed work or alter request bytes.
tests/test_experiment_maf.py.oracle: Validated input snapshots and subprocess receipts establish ordering and failure propagation; optional tests execute a native MAF graph.
tests/test_experiment_maf.py.overlap: Binding tests simulate external stages; the opt-in graph checks the actual MAF boundary.

tests/test_experiment_model.py.risk: Reservation or promotion guards might fail under modeled concurrency, crash, or stale-ref transitions.
tests/test_experiment_model.py.oracle: Finite state exploration must preserve stated invariants, while deliberately weakened transitions yield counterexamples; the optional pinned TLC checker exercises TLA+ specifications.
tests/test_experiment_model.py.overlap: Model checks assumptions and bounded transitions independently; real SQLite and Git tests exercise implementation behavior.

tests/test_experiment_native_check.py.risk: A native test command could be counted as passing without real work or with changed case data.
tests/test_experiment_native_check.py.oracle: Real local scripts produce passing, failing, empty, timed-out and malformed outcomes, with work counts and case digests checked.
tests/test_experiment_native_check.py.overlap: Exercises adapter parsing and execution independently from controller provenance.

tests/test_experiment_native_integration.risk: A controller could run a different native configuration or accept a substituted evaluator.
tests/test_experiment_native_integration.oracle: Real native test execution and configuration, parser and argument mutation cases must preserve frozen identity and reject drift.
tests/test_experiment_native_integration.overlap: Checks compiled controller-to-adapter integration rather than every native output case.

tests/test_experiment_runner.py.risk: A trial could execute the wrong source tree or undeclared command, overrun its deadline, or silently accept incomplete execution.
tests/test_experiment_runner.py.oracle: Frozen temporary Git trees and real subprocesses establish status, bounded outputs and cleanup, including a detached-pipe child after normal exit; clocks simulate export/deadline boundaries.
tests/test_experiment_runner.py.overlap: Checks materialization and process outcomes; integration tests separately bind them to evaluation decisions.

tests/test_flowify.py.risk: Workflow scaffolds or asynchronous file bindings could escape scope, publish partial output or race cancellation.
tests/test_flowify.py.oracle: Exercise real scaffold/inspection tools, controlled completion/cancellation and corrupted files; compare hashes, stable results and rollback effects.
tests/test_flowify.py.overlap: Concurrency scheduling here validates binding I/O; task leases and resource scheduling are different SDLC invariants.

tests/test_graphify.py.risk: Provider-specific skill views can lose required reference bytes or redirect writes through a symlink.
tests/test_graphify.py.oracle: Compare installed view bytes and exercise actual rejection of a symlinked generated directory.
tests/test_graphify.py.overlap: Removed duplicate pinned-snapshot inventory test; installer already verifies immutable vendors. Retain first-view planning and actual byte-copy consumer behavior.

tests/test_grok_learn.py.risk: Experience evidence could be mistaken for user authority, or cache inspection could follow outside the selected home.
tests/test_grok_learn.py.oracle: Write and inspect isolated ledgers and cache fixtures; assert no authority promotion, exact deduplication and no unintended filesystem writes.
tests/test_grok_learn.py.overlap: Experiences/locator behavior is not correction activation; that lifecycle stays in test_learn.

tests/test_hill_climb.py.risk: A noisy, regressing or workload-changing candidate could be accepted as a measured improvement.
tests/test_hill_climb.py.oracle: Feed paired receipts with missing samples, drift, leakage and quality regressions; assert actual keep/reject decisions and evidence requirements.
tests/test_hill_climb.py.overlap: Decision algebra uses controlled receipts; live benchmark/provider execution is intentionally outside this offline gate.

tests/test_install.py.risk: Source-only setup, wrong workspace selection, lost host instructions or destructive reapply can leave consumers silently misconfigured.
tests/test_install.py.oracle: Compare the full owned link set, real native Codex prompt, Git index gate, uninstall effects, isolated source hooksPath, two Serena argv/cwd pairs and mismatched archive bytes; exercise shared-directory cleanup, foreign aliases and teardown after switching hook managers.
tests/test_install.py.overlap: The installer exercises project selection and ownership. Server tool discovery and provider authorization use separate integration checks.

tests/test_instructify.py.risk: Instruction section updates could overwrite foreign/manual content or apply a stale plan after concurrent changes.
tests/test_instructify.py.oracle: Plan/apply/remove real scoped instruction files; mutate ownership and source state, inject write failures and inspect rollback and preserved bytes.
tests/test_instructify.py.overlap: Owns general section/plan semantics; installer only tests its concrete startup integration, not every planner case.

tests/test_learn.py.risk: Candidate, superseded or retired corrections could become active without user evidence or lose history.
tests/test_learn.py.oracle: Capture real local correction events and inspect active rendered rules, recurrence, supersession, retirement and corrupt-ledger rejection.
tests/test_learn.py.overlap: Core correction transitions are here; scoped storage, experiences and session consolidation have independent suites.

tests/test_learn_help.py.risk: A help/discovery request could initialize stores or silently route to a mutating whole-session workflow.
tests/test_learn_help.py.oracle: Invoke real help/topic CLIs and standalone copies, compare output contracts and exact before/after bytes of existing state.
tests/test_learn_help.py.overlap: Help read-only scope is its own public contract; no recreation of correction lifecycle tests.

tests/test_lever.py.risk: Paired statistical comparison could accept insufficient evidence or miscompute a known result.
tests/test_lever.py.oracle: Execute the actual helper tests, including the minimum-evidence rejection and known paired-statistic result.
tests/test_lever.py.overlap: Retains one external helper contract, not duplicate statistical assertions in root Python tests.

tests/test_lintify.py.risk: Linter scaffolding could overwrite an existing path, follow escaping templates or leave partial output under concurrency.
tests/test_lintify.py.oracle: Run scaffold helper against collision, corruption, simultaneous writer and injected copy-error cases; inspect exact preserved and rolled-back files.
tests/test_lintify.py.overlap: Template syntax/locks are discovery contracts; native third-party linter semantics are explicitly separate from helper packaging.

tests/test_repo_quality.py.risk: Published plugin commands, bounded review snapshots and measured release gates can disagree with the shipped install surface.
tests/test_repo_quality.py.oracle: Check immutable MCP definitions and reject invalid launch properties. Inspect retained target verification evidence in the bounded snapshot.
tests/test_repo_quality.py.overlap: Removed configuration-shape test and its custom parser; retain consumer-level manifest, snapshot, transport and opt-in live judge checks. Live judge remains explicitly skipped offline.

tests/test_reusify.py.risk: Aliased or overlapping evidence could create false reuse counts, escape scope or execute catalog instructions.
tests/test_reusify.py.oracle: Exercise real lookup/count/scaffold contracts with symlinks, duplicate spans and controlled file I/O; inspect bounded stable results and no unintended execution.
tests/test_reusify.py.overlap: Counting evidence differs from semantic equivalence; reuse-catalog boundary tests do not duplicate code-generation or task scheduling.

tests/test_sdlc.py.risk: Task ownership, accepted heads or reviewed evidence could be bypassed across dependency transitions or concurrent execution.
tests/test_sdlc.py.oracle: Use real Git fixtures and controlled leases/evidence mutations; assert rejection, invalidated descendants, isolated sparse worktrees and exact merge gates.
tests/test_sdlc.py.overlap: Graph/proof semantics here complement durable transaction/restart behavior in test_sdlc_store. Example transitions are not TLA+ or Lean proofs.

tests/test_sdlc_store.py.risk: Concurrent workers or recovery could double-claim tasks, lose committed state or accept stale lease tokens after restart.
tests/test_sdlc_store.py.oracle: Run isolated durable-store and multi-process fixtures; inspect persisted state, exclusive tokens, crash rollback, revision invalidation and compiled CLI equivalence.
tests/test_sdlc_store.py.overlap: Durability/process ownership is distinct from in-memory graph policy; tests share risks but assert different persistence boundaries, not duplicated unit mocks.

tests/test_session_learning.py.risk: Session evidence could silently schedule changes, merge active/unrelated sessions or leak out of ignored workspace storage.
tests/test_session_learning.py.oracle: Use actual lifecycle/review/plan CLIs and isolated files, malformed graphs, binary/oversized evidence and symlink cases; assert explicit scope and saved evidence.
tests/test_session_learning.py.overlap: Includes the explicit behavioral-test routing kind alongside other decision-record mechanisms.

tests/test_skill_evolution.py.risk: Skill improvement could publish changed or unanswered candidates using stale proof or weak substring grading.
tests/test_skill_evolution.py.oracle: Copy standalone packages, execute scoped improvement handoffs and mutate graded source/evidence; assert no false completion or cache/global writes.
tests/test_skill_evolution.py.overlap: The Learn distribution check includes Testify as a self-contained mounted authoring subskill.

tests/test_skill_normalization.py.risk: Shared typed skill transport could ignore native failures, change scope or omit resources after commit/clone.
tests/test_skill_normalization.py.oracle: Execute every owned compiled model/report boundary and representative real native helpers; test tampered evidence, raw args, process cleanup and standalone clone behavior.
tests/test_skill_normalization.py.overlap: The shared verification contract rejects contradictory Testify fault-sensitivity claims.

tests/test_skill_routing.py.risk: A newly installed skill could be undiscoverable, duplicate another name or leave the generated routing guide stale.
tests/test_skill_routing.py.oracle: Run inventory parsing and actual catalog/guide validation with missing/stale/duplicate entries and import side-effect probes.
tests/test_skill_routing.py.overlap: Removed source-substring CI test; routing consumer validation remains distinct from physical install placement.

tests/test_skillify_workflows.py.risk: A draft or standalone generated skill could falsely claim implementation or publish partial package conversion.
tests/test_skillify_workflows.py.oracle: Run real scaffold/conversion and frozen workflow commands with collisions, concurrent writers and copied packages; assert output, rejection and publication rollback.
tests/test_skillify_workflows.py.overlap: Owns authoring conversion semantics; generic compiler and parser behavior have dedicated suites instead of duplicated per-skill edge cases.

tests/test_stack_runner.py.risk: Registry precedence or provider selection could execute in a source/cache workspace or silently fall back to inference.
tests/test_stack_runner.py.oracle: Invoke actual CLI/tool surfaces against isolated registries, explicit projects and compiled fixtures; assert selected paths, output, rejection and state preservation.
tests/test_stack_runner.py.overlap: Runner precedence is distinct from installer launcher creation. The optional native SDK check stays opt-in and performs no model calls.

tests/test_state_layout.py.risk: Shared scoped-state discovery or symlink handling could write secrets/evidence to another root or expose private sessions.
tests/test_state_layout.py.oracle: Run real state helper/CLI across explicit roots, concurrent initialization, ignore exceptions and symlink attacks; inspect files and unchanged nonselected scopes.
tests/test_state_layout.py.overlap: Removed duplicated shared-helper byte/reference check; check_skills already gates it. Retain primitive state ownership and ignore behavior; feature suites check only their own concrete integration.

tests/test_unslop.py.risk: Artifact grading could pass without actual inspection or current artifact/catalog bytes, or treat uncertain corrections as authority.
tests/test_unslop.py.oracle: Capture real correction batches and grade retained files/images; mutate evidence/catalog and inspect rejected completion and legitimate exceptions.
tests/test_unslop.py.overlap: Owns grading coverage/catalog semantics; shared correction persistence is exercised only at its feature integration boundary.
